rules.name: Martial Training
rules.text: In step 3 of the aftermath sequence you can pick up to 3 friendly Knight fighters to take part in martial training. Each of those fighters earns d6 bonus experience.

rules.name: Search the City
rules.text: In step 4 of the aftermath sequence, if you won the battle, you gain 1 exploration re-roll.

rules.name: Blasphemous Study
rules.text: In step 6 of the aftermath sequence, you can pick 1 of the following: Scry Ancient Scrolls – roll a dice for each Wizard in your warband and record an ongoing tally on your Warband Roster; each time the tally exceeds a multiple of 20, you can pick a Wizard in your warband to earn enough experience to receive their next advancement. Brew Concoctions – roll a dice for each Wizard in your warband; for each roll of 5+, you can add 1 Vial of Poison to your stash.

rules.name: Demonic Communion
rules.text: In step 6 of the aftermath sequence, roll 3d6 if you won the battle, 2d6 if you lost: 2 Damnation – your leader is killed, and you can add a Demonic Rotspawn to your warband for 0 silver; it bears the name of your former leader. 3–8 Silence – no effect. 9–12 Minor Boon – your leader earns 5 bonus experience. 13–15 Demonic Ally – you can add a Rot Demon or a Rotling to your warband for 0 silver. 16+ Major Boon – your leader earns 20 bonus experience.

rules.name: Venerate Living Saints
rules.text: Each time a Dreg Cultist in this warband gains a level of Black Rot, they earn 5 bonus experience.

rules.name: Canonise the Fallen
rules.text: Each time a fighter in this warband is killed, every Dreg Cultist in this warband earns 10 additional bonus experience in step 3 of the aftermath sequence.

rules.name: Nurture Sickness
rules.text: In step six of the aftermath sequence, you can pick 1 friendly fighter with any temporary injuries. Remove 1 of their temporary injuries, they gain 1 level of Black Rot.

rules.name: Medicinal Remedies
rules.text: In step six of the aftermath sequence, you receive 1 Healing Tonic.

rules.name: Unholy Pacts
rules.text: In step 3 of the aftermath sequence you can pick 1 friendly Demon to earn d6 bonus experience.

rules.name: The Bell Tolls
rules.text: Once per battle, when you activate your Leader, you can say the Bell Tower tolls. If you do so, friendly fighters gain the Unshakeable rule until the end of the round: this fighter ignores the Fear special rule and all rules that would make them scatter (eg. the Scare weapon trait).

rules.name: Hive-spawn
rules.text: In step 6 of the aftermath sequence, you can roll a dice. On a 5+, you can recruit 1 Bloat Fly to your warband for 0 silver.

rules.name: Congregation Collection
rules.text: When you collect income from your stronghold, if you lost the battle, you receive an additional 3d6 silver.
